title: agoseris heterophylla var. crenulata
intro:
Agoseris heterophylla var. crenulata, commonly known as Crenulate Agoseris, is a plant species belonging to the sunflower family (Asteraceae). It is a perennial herb with medicinal properties, traditionally used by Native American communities to treat various health issues. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial actions, which may help alleviate symptoms of digestive disorders and wound healing. Bioactive constituents of Agoseris heterophylla var. crenulata include sesquiterpene lactones, phenolic compounds, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties.
